_context.boardToasts.createdInactive: Toast after a coworker was created on the board. {name} is the coworker's name.
_context.boardToasts.importInterruptedHint: Under 'The import was interrupted' (a template import): the user's machine (the server running their coworkers) may hold a partial import.
_context.isoBoard.boxCta: Pill on an empty Box of the board. {name} is the Box's name. Keep it under 34 characters with a short name.
_context.contextMenu.moveToBox: Submenu of a coworker on the board: move it into another Box (a group of coworkers on the board).
_context.contextMenu.duplicate: Menu item (verb): make a copy of this coworker.
_context.contextMenu.share: Menu item (verb): share this coworker through a link.
_context.toolbar.placementPrompt: Shown while the person places a coworker on the board grid. {name} is the coworker's name.
_context.toolbar.placementProgress: A template installs several coworkers one after another: which one is being placed.
_context.toolbar.template: Button opening the template library (ready-made coworkers).
_context.toolbar.unplaced: Count of coworkers not yet placed on the board.
_context.isoBoard.settingUpTemplate: {title} is the name of a template being installed.
_context.isoBoard.installTemplate: {title} is the name of a template the person came to install.
_context.isoBoard.addBoxOnSide: Button on the side of a Box on the board: adds a new Box next to it.
_context.discoveries.statusDigging: Onboarding: Rerun is researching the person's company. {name} is the company name.
_context.discoveries.statusDone: Title once the research on the company is done. {name} is the company name.
_context.discoveries.found: Badge: how many facts were found about the company.
_context.discoveries.cards.brain.title: Company Brain: the pages of knowledge about the company that coworkers read before working.
_context.discoveries.cards.registry.people: Headcount from a public company registry. {headcount} is a number or a range like 11-50.
_context.discoveries.cards.person.title: {firstName} is the first name of the person found on LinkedIn.
